entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help. I bought a ProFit Jersey a while back, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. It's the wrong size for me. I was so excited when it arrived, but when I finally tried it on for a big ride, it was just way too tight. I feel terrible about it.
I understand. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?

Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF789012. I've been a VeloFit customer for years. I was just really hoping this would work out, and honestly, I really needed this money back if it didn't.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here. It looks like the jersey was delivered 49 days ago. Let me just check our policy... one moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. Our return policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, thank goodness! Are you sure? That's such a relief. I was worried I'd be stuck with it.
Absolutely. We can definitely process this for you. Since the issue was that it was too tight, would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
You can do an exchange? That would be perfect! I loved the jersey itself, it was just the sizing that was off. A size up would be great.

Excellent choice. I have just initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email on file now. Just send the original jersey back to us, and we'll ship out the new size as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's wonderful. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really turned my day around.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Have a great day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives!
